title: D8 criticism experiment — the predictions of PREREG.md §13, as universal statements one record can refute

claims.statement: No harness run reaches a terminal without ever rendering an open criticism to the seat that writes the next candidate: every terminal root carries at least one section plan naming dr.open-criticisms.
claims.note: PREREG §13.1. This is the confound the 2026-09-08 audit named: 0 of 196 model-written attacks were ever exposed to a later conjecture dispatch, so every earlier statement about what criticism achieved was a statement about criticism that could not have achieved anything. A refutation here means the arm measured nothing about criticism and its comparison is uninterpretable, not that the harness is broken.

claims.statement: Every harness arm records at least one observe-only criticism as scrutiny — the Measure the discharge channel walks to find open criticisms.
claims.note: PREREG §13.1's other half. An observe_only criticism mints no warrant and therefore produces no attack edge at all, so reading only state.att would miss the entire population this experiment is about (DR-CON-discharge-channel's first Trap). If this claim is refuted the channel has nothing to render, and D8-RENDER-01 cannot mean what it appears to.

claims.statement: Every harness arm actually dispatches criticism: no terminal root carries zero Crit events.
claims.note: The floor beneath every other criticism claim. An arm that dispatched no criticism at all is INCONCLUSIVE for every comparison it enters, and is not evidence that criticism does nothing.

claims.statement: Every harness run reaches a CLEAN typed terminal: no root stops for a reason outside {max_cycles, budget_exhausted}.
claims.note: PREREG §13.6. The operator's law of 2026-08-29: exhaustion is a clean stop. The organiser tranche's ARM R was typed operational_failure on a budget denial, which that law forbids and which its PARKED P8 records as a defect — so this claim can be refuted by a harness defect rather than by anything this experiment did, and a refutation must be read against P8 before it is read as an arm failure.

claims.statement: No harness run reaches a terminal over a record that fails its own replay validation.
claims.note: PREREG §6's second refusal. The organiser tranche's ARM R reached completed over a record carrying three attempt-validity violations, composition succeeded on it regardless, and its verdict was INCONCLUSIVE for exactly that reason (its PREREG Amendment 9, and its PARKED P9). A refutation costs the arm its unit. STANDING WARNING, registered in advance: if run-status.json carries no replay_valid field, this claim survives having been unable to fail, and the standing line is the sentence to read — the judging instrument's own refusal is the load-bearing check, not this claim.

claims.statement: ARM A mints at least one ARGUMENTATIVE warrant — a status moved by something a critic seat wrote rather than by a mechanical verdict.
claims.note: PREREG §13.3, and REGISTERED AS THE PREDICTION MOST LIKELY TO BE REFUTED. Measured 2026-09-09 across the 20 most criticism-heavy committed roots in this repository: 1141 warrants, every one demonstrative, not one argumentative. If this is refuted, that is a FINDING about granted authority on this configuration — not a broken instrument and not a failed arm. The instrument's ability to report a non-zero argumentative count is proved separately on a fixture, with a mutation, because no committed root can prove it (proof/ARGUMENTATIVE_COLUMN_LIVE.txt).

claims.statement: No observe-only arm mints an argumentative warrant: ARM C and ARM V never move a status by a critic's prose.
claims.note: The CONTROL for D8-AUTHORITY-ARGUMENTATIVE-01, and it points the opposite way. observe_only is defined as recording scrutiny and minting nothing, so a refutation here would mean the authority gate leaked — which would invalidate the A-vs-C comparison entirely, since the two arms would no longer differ in authority. This claim and the one above cannot both be refuted without the experiment being uninterpretable.

claims.statement: No observe-only arm calls a judge: ARM C and ARM V never dispatch an adjudication.
claims.note: The second control on the authority difference, at the dispatch level rather than the warrant level. ARM C and ARM V leave JUDGE_SEATS_ENABLED at the shipped default false and cannot obtain a cross-family ensemble in any case (both are single-family; require_cross_family_judge_ensemble refuses them, measured at step 28). A refutation means judges fired where the configuration said they could not.

claims.statement: ARM V's contentless objections travel the same route as ARM C's: every ARM V root records criticism as scrutiny exactly as ARM C does.
claims.note: PREREG §13.2. ARM V exists to isolate the CONTENT of criticism, so its objections must differ from ARM C's in content and in nothing else. If ARM V's objections took a different path through the record, C-vs-V would measure the path and not the content, and the arm would answer a question nobody asked.

claims.statement: No harness run exceeds the operator's 500000-token ceiling.
claims.note: The ceiling the operator set. A refutation means an arm was not measured at the stated spend and no equal-spend claim may be made from it — which is exactly the disclosure the organiser tranche's Amendment 8 had to make when a continuation raised its own ceiling.
